meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后,它能控制真实浏览器:按你的要求打开网页、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据等;操作中会记住页面状态,可分步完成复杂任务,也能截图排查问题。
howto.when: 当你要 Claude 操作浏览器时触发,比如“打开某网址”“点击某元素”“截图”等。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截图给我看
say.note: Claude 会打开页面并保存一张截图给你。

say.text: 点击页面上叫“登录”的按钮
say.note: Claude 会用可访问性快照定位并点击它。

say.text: 抓取这个页面上的所有新闻标题
say.note: Claude 会提取文本并整理给你。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a real browser: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, scrape data, etc. It remembers page state across steps, so it can complete multi-step tasks incrementally and take screenshots to debug issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks Claude to operate a browser, e.g., 'go to a URL', 'click an element', 'take a screenshot', etc.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot for me
say_en.note: Claude will open the page and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Click the button labeled 'Login' on the page
say_en.note: Claude will use the accessibility snapshot to find and click it.

say_en.text: Scrape all the news headlines on this page
say_en.note: Claude will extract the text and list them for you.
